ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather and its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather and its resources.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Nitrogen gas only
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Only water vapour

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Heat and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Heat and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Heat and its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Heat and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Heat and its resources.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Plants and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Plants and its resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Plants and its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Plants and its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Plants and its resources.

7. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dangers of heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dangers of heat.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dangers of heat.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dangers of heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dangers of heat.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals and its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals and its resources.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Animals and its resources.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

12. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Keeping safe from? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Keeping safe from.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Keeping safe from.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Keeping safe from.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Keeping safe from.

14. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 0 °C

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of heat in? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of heat in.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of heat in.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of heat in.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of heat in.

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment collecting rain water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Caring For Energy environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Keeping safe from and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Water its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
